title: winy creamy japanese corn tacos
description: a refreshing and creamy post-workout dish inspired by kansai cuisine, featuring brine-dried vegetables and corn tortillas.

ingredients.name: brine-dried corn
ingredients.notes: brine the corn for 30 minutes, then dry it in the oven at 150 degrees for 2 hours.

instructions: heat 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter in a pan over medium heat.
add the brine-dried corn and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
add the grated yamaimo and cook for another 2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
add the dashi broth and bring to a simmer.
reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, or until the broth has slightly thickened.
stir in the heavy cream and cook for another minute, or until heated through.
add the white wine and cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
assemble the tacos by spooning the corn mixture onto a warmed tortilla and garnishing with chopped green onions and shichimi togarashi, if desired.
